decisions.title: City of Albuquerque Annual Comprehensive Financial Report, Fiscal Year 2014
decisions.description: Presents Albuquerque’s independently audited financial statements for Fiscal Year 2014, including government-wide and fund finances, revenues, expenditures, debt, pensions, capital assets, budget comparisons, notes, and long-term statistical trends.
processing_notes: Original authoritative 306-page PDF preserved without modification after complete text extraction and representative-page visual review.
User explicitly approved production R2 upload of the 257,383,297-byte original on 2026-08-24.
decisions.large_file_assessment: The official 306-page PDF is unusually large because its audited statements, notes, schedules, tables, and graphics are encoded inefficiently. No smaller authoritative edition is linked. Optimization could alter the source or reduce fidelity, so the explicitly approved original is preserved unchanged.
